newsitem.title: BOSNIA: U.S. soldier dies of gunshot wound in Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soldier dies of gunshot wound in Bosnia.

text.p: An American soldier serving with the NATO-led peacekeeping force in Bosnia died on Monday of a gunshot wound to the head, spokesman Cory Check told Reuters.
"The death is being treated as an isolated incident and is not related to any former warring faction," Check said.
The soldier was pronounced dead in a military hospital near the U.S. base in Tuzla, northeast Bosnia, at 3.10 p.m. (1310 GMT).
No other details were about him were available but Check said the soldier's weapon was found with his body.
Around 8,500 American soldiers are serving in the multinational force which first deployed in December 1995 to police the Dayton peace agreement that ended four years of war in former Yugoslavia.
Ten U.S. soldiers have died, all of them through accidents, natural causes or suicide.
